nodes.name: content-bash.module.css
nodes.summary: CSS module for the bash tool view in session-share rendering: a terminal-style card with a centered header (macOS-style terminal icon drawn via mask-image), Shiki-highlighted command and output panes, and a 10-line line-clamp on output that lifts when data-expanded is set.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses display: contents on the root so slot children participate directly in the parent flex layout; the terminal icon is a CSS mask over a custom property (--term-icon) rather than an inline SVG.

nodes.name: content-code.module.css
nodes.summary: Minimal CSS module for the generic code block view: a bordered, padded surface with Shiki background overrides and a data-flush variant that strips border, background, and padding for embedding inside larger blocks.

nodes.name: content-diff.module.css
nodes.summary: CSS module for diff rendering with a responsive dual layout: a side-by-side desktop grid (before/after columns, +/- gutters, red/green row tinting that also overrides the Shiki pre background) and a stacked mobile variant that swaps in below 40rem.
nodes.languageNotes: Maintains two parallel rule sets (desktop grid vs mobile stack) toggled by a single max-width 40rem media query; added/removed markers are ::before pseudo-elements positioned in a ch-based gutter.

nodes.name: content-error.module.css
nodes.summary: CSS module for error output rendering: monospace pre blocks with semantically colored spans (data-color red/dimmed, uppercase label markers, separators) and a 7-line line-clamp on the content section toggled by data-expanded, plus a subtle expand button.

nodes.name: content-markdown.module.css
nodes.summary: CSS module for markdown message bodies in the share view: a full typography stack (headings, nested lists, bordered tables, blockquotes, Shiki code blocks) inside a 3-line line-clamped container that expands via data-expanded, with copy-button positioning.
nodes.languageNotes: Inline code is decorated with literal backtick characters via ::before/::after pseudo-elements, visually marking code spans without extra markup; table outer borders are stripped for a clean card look.

nodes.name: content-text.module.css
nodes.summary: CSS module for plain text message bubbles: compact and data-theme variants (invert renders a solid blue bubble with inverted text, blue a tinted surface), a 3-line clamped text slot with expand button, and absolute positioning for the copy button.

nodes.name: copy-button.module.css
nodes.summary: CSS module for the copy-to-clipboard icon button: absolutely positioned and hidden by default, revealed with a fade whenever any ancestor is hovered, and switching to green on data-copied for confirmation feedback.
nodes.languageNotes: The *:hover > .root universal selector reveals the button on ancestor hover without coupling to any specific parent class — a deliberate CSS-modules pattern for reusable overlay affordances.

nodes.name: part.module.css
nodes.summary: The largest share-view stylesheet, styling every part type in the session transcript: a left decoration column with copy anchor link and copied tooltip, reasoning and assistant text bubbles, per-tool layouts (bash, edit, task, read, grep, webfetch) sized via sm/md/lg width tiers, a todos checklist with priority colors and status checkbox states, and a key-value grid for tool arguments.
nodes.languageNotes: The completed-todo checkmark is drawn purely in CSS with a clip-path polygon plus inset box-shadow fill; per-tool result widths are tiered through --sm/--md/--lg-tool-width custom properties.
